g.text: Comparison with the exact PCA-selected random pose; the level sea surface and modeled waterline are explicit.
10/24 refined states met the descriptive attitude and strict size criteria; all had the engine absent and all six midspan/tip cells fully flooded.
Selected state: height RMSE 0.796 m; PCA loss 0.3421; modeled retained air 49.3 m³.

text.style: font-size: 7.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #5d4b3e

g.text: Post-hoc conditional sensitivity, not a flooding probability or global continuous optimum. The 3 × 3 cells and modeled air volume are coarse equivalent-buoyancy assumptions, not documented Boeing tank bays or tank volume.
